summary: Frontend hook dependency testing - Fixed 3 critical runtime errors caused by useCallback/useEffect ordering issues in Pricing.jsx, RitualBuilder.jsx, and OracleReadings.jsx. All pages now load without crashes.

fixed_issues.issue: Cannot access 'capturePayPalOrder' before initialization - useEffect referenced useCallback functions before they were defined
fixed_issues.fix: Moved useCallback definitions (fetchData, checkPaymentStatus, capturePayPalOrder) before the useEffect that references them

fixed_issues.issue: Cannot access 'fetchData' and 'logRitualComplete' before initialization - useEffects referenced useCallback functions before they were defined
fixed_issues.fix: Moved fetchData useCallback before its useEffect, and moved timer useEffect after logRitualComplete useCallback

fixed_issues.issue: Cannot access 'fetchPastReadings' before initialization - useEffect referenced useCallback function before it was defined
fixed_issues.fix: Moved fetchPastReadings useCallback before the useEffect that references it

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Pricing.jsx - useEffect was referencing capturePayPalOrder, checkPaymentStatus, fetchData before they were defined with useCallback
FIXED: RitualBuilder.jsx - Two useEffects were referencing fetchData and logRitualComplete before they were defined with useCallback
FIXED: OracleReadings.jsx - useEffect was referencing fetchPastReadings before it was defined with useCallback
Pattern: When using useCallback with useEffect dependencies, always define the useCallback BEFORE the useEffect that references it

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All tested pages load without runtime errors

test_credentials: No auth needed for most pages
